The name Gazala carries the meaning “Gazelle-like” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gazala usually hope their child will grow to embody gazelle-like and live with faith, good character and purpose.
